label: Git hygiene
text: Conventional Commits with scope (feat(tls):, fix(release):, docs:, chore(release): vX.Y.Z). Subjects state the resulting behaviour, e.g. 'the renewal sweep asks about a name before it builds a path from it'. Changes go through PR/MR. Decisions live in commits and issues, not summary docs.
